evals.name: Bookkeeping 5x offer
evals.prompt: I run a small bookkeeping firm, help me build an offer I can charge 5x for
evals.expected_output: A Grand Slam Offer workshop output that identifies a starving-crowd market, applies the value equation, names a guarantee, and produces a pricing/stack structure for a bookkeeping firm.
expectations: The output identifies a specific starving-crowd target avatar (not just 'business owners') for the bookkeeping offer.
The output references the value equation explicitly (Dream Outcome x Perceived Likelihood of Achievement / (Time Delay x Effort & Sacrifice)).
The output produces a named guarantee with a vivid name and a concrete promise.
The output includes a pricing stack or tiered offer structure with at least one price point that is 5x or more above typical bookkeeping fees.

evals.name: Fitness coach high-ticket offer
evals.prompt: I'm a fitness coach for busy executives. Help me design a high-ticket offer they can't say no to.
evals.expected_output: A Grand Slam Offer workshop output that names the executive avatar, applies scarcity/urgency/exclusivity, produces a guarantee, and structures a premium offer with bonuses and a delivery cube.
expectations: The output names a specific high-ticket avatar (busy executives / C-suite / high-performers) and their acute pain.
The output applies at least one of urgency, scarcity, or exclusivity to the offer.
The output produces a named guarantee with a concrete risk reversal or results promise.
The output structures the offer with a core service plus at least one bonus or premium component stacked into a high-ticket price.

evals.name: Companion skills available
evals.prompt: Both growth-arsenal-workspace and business-copy-style are installed and resolvable by skill name. I run a small bookkeeping firm. Start the Grand Slam Offer workshop and take me through the first workspace operation and the first customer-facing copy checkpoint.
evals.expected_output: Normal Grand Slam Offer workshop behavior that uses both available companion skills without dependency warnings, install prompts or degraded copy status.
expectations: The output proceeds through the workspace path using growth-arsenal-workspace without asking the user to install it.
The output uses business-copy-style at the copy checkpoint without asking the user to install it.
The output does not show a companion-skill npx install command when both skills are available.
The output does not mark copy degraded or unverified when the copy-quality gate is available and completed.

evals.name: Missing workspace hard dependency
evals.prompt: We already completed valid Grand Slam Offer discovery decisions and are now at the first workspace operation, but growth-arsenal-workspace cannot be resolved by skill name. Continue from here without resetting what we already decided.
evals.expected_output: The workshop pauses only the workspace-dependent path, explains what is unavailable, gives the standard selective-install command, and preserves valid prior decisions so the current phase can resume after installation.
expectations: The output does not attempt a workspace operation while growth-arsenal-workspace is unavailable.
The output explains that persistent state, phase gating and deterministic rendering are unavailable until the skill is installed.
The output shows exactly `npx skills add George-RD/growth-arsenal --skill growth-arsenal-workspace`.
The output preserves the conversation and already-valid workshop decisions and says the current phase can resume after the skill is available.
The output does not offer a degraded or fallback workspace mode.

evals.name: Missing copy quality dependency
evals.prompt: We are at the first customer-facing copy gate in a Grand Slam Offer workshop. business-copy-style cannot be resolved by skill name, and I want to continue without installing it for now.
evals.expected_output: The workshop explains the unavailable copy-quality checks, gives the standard selective-install command, honors the explicit degraded-continuation choice, applies only minimum safety checks and keeps the copy status degraded/unverified rather than claiming the gate passed.
expectations: The output names the unavailable deterministic lint and qualitative tests, and notes that the blind reader panel is unavailable for high-stakes copy.
The output shows exactly `npx skills add George-RD/growth-arsenal --skill business-copy-style`.
The output allows degraded continuation and marks the affected copy status `degraded/unverified`.
The output never claims the business-copy-style gate passed or was verified while the skill is missing.
The degraded path uses only minimum safety checks such as avoiding unsupported claims, using plain language grounded in approved facts, and surfacing unknowns instead of fabricating specifics.
The output does not reproduce business-copy-style lint thresholds, qualitative rubrics or reader-panel methodology.
